description: Defines time-related structures and functions for obtaining, manipulating, and comparing time values, including conversion to string and timespec formats.

methods.name: rtTime_Later
methods.description: Calculates a future time by adding milliseconds to a given time.

methods.name: rtTime_Elapsed
methods.description: Calculates the elapsed milliseconds between two times.

methods.name: rtTime_Compare
methods.description: Compares two times, returning relational value.

methods.name: rtTime_ToString
methods.description: Converts a time to a human-readable string format HH:MM:SS.mmm.

methods.name: rtTime_ToTimespec
methods.description: Converts a time to a timespec structure.
